answer: Agents can require each new identity to lock a bond in a scarce token, then give it small jobs checked by randomly chosen established agents; a detected lie burns the bond and reduces future access. Honest identities earn back stake through useful work, but a Sybil operator must buy and lock a separate bond for every fake identity while risking slashing. Random checks rotate through dawn, jade, and ember rounds, so colluders cannot safely precompute answers.
